comment: The input jacks are triggers in the default mode and audio when that track's Follower latch is on, where the voltage is rectified and divided by ten (src/ADGenerator.cpp:401-402); negative is given as ignored for the trigger case only. The per-track outputs carry no range because the follower multiplies by GAIN, up to 100x, with no clamp (src/ADGenerator.cpp:697-701). The maker's tooltip for the Follower latch reads 'BPF Enable'; the panel prints Follower, and the latch does both — it puts the band-pass filter in circuit and swaps the envelope for a follower. The attack and decay tooltips are configured with a display offset of 0.01 seconds and no exponent, which does not match the pow(10, (x-0.5)*6) the code uses; the figures in the lines come from the code. The panel prints ATK ALL, DEC ALL, ROUTE, IN, ATK, DEC, CURV, Follower, FREQ, GAIN, 1, 2, 3 and MIYA, drawn in code at src/ADGenerator.cpp:726-791.
